items.text: Among adults within their first six months of systemic cancer therapy at the centre, what is the prevalence of moderate or severe financial toxicity, and how does it differ by age, income, employment and travel distance?
items.population: Adults within the first six months of systemic cancer therapy at the regional cancer centre
items.intervention: Age, household income, employment change and travel distance (exposures)
items.outcome: Moderate or severe financial toxicity on the validated 11-item questionnaire
items.setting: Four day units of a regional cancer centre

items.text: In the same patients, how well does the financial problems checkbox on the distress screening form agree with moderate or severe financial toxicity on the questionnaire?
items.population: Respondents with a completed distress screening form
items.comparator: Questionnaire score in the moderate or severe range
items.outcome: Proportion of affected patients identified by the checkbox and agreement beyond chance
items.time: Screening form within four weeks of the questionnaire

finer: Revised after the protocol was drafted: restricting to the first six months of treatment matches when spending peaks and when the navigation service would act, and the checkbox question the investigator asked for is now explicit.
summary: Revised: population restricted to the first six months of treatment, and the screening agreement question added.
